purpose: The service provides real-time fraud scoring for payments by processing events as they happen and making decisions within seconds.

components.name: scoring-engine
components.evidence: The scoring-engine runs as two replicas that share one Kafka consumer group

components.name: payment-events (MSK)
components.evidence: The scoring-engine consumes payment events from payment-events (MSK)

components.name: decisions-db
components.evidence: decisions-db (PostgreSQL) holds the decisions together with the customer attributes that were scored

components.name: scoring_audit
components.evidence: Every decision writes an audit record to the log group scoring_audit
